tooltip_definitions.Systems Protection Segment: Enclosures, data center liquid cooling (CDUs, manifolds, high-density server racks), and utility switchgear systems ($1,098.0M in Q3 2026, up +53.4% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Electrical Connections Segment: Critical electrical fastening, grounding, bonding, and connectivity solutions across commercial and industrial infrastructure ($416.9M in Q3 2026, up +23.2% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Data Solutions & Liquid Cooling: Proprietary direct-to-chip liquid cooling loops, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and intelligent server cabinets delivering >100% YoY growth.
tooltip_definitions.Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs): High-efficiency thermal management pumps circulating liquid coolant across dense GPU compute clusters to prevent thermal throttling.
tooltip_definitions.Maverick Power Acquisition: Strategic acquisition closed on October 1, 2026, adding pre-fabricated modular power skids, busway, and switchgear to broaden data center power reach.
tooltip_definitions.Trachte Integration: Engineered control building manufacturer acquired to provide customized utility-grade enclosures and modular substation protection.
tooltip_definitions.Adjusted Return on Sales: Adjusted operating income as a percentage of net sales (22.1% in Q3 2026, up +190 bps YoY vs 20.2% in Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Organic Sales Growth: Net sales growth excluding the impact of foreign currency fluctuations and acquisitions completed within the preceding 12 months (+44% organic in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net profit from continuing operations divided by diluted ordinary shares ($1.23 per share in Q3 2026, up +68% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Adjusted Diluted EPS: Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share excluding acquisition amortization, integration fees, and tariff items ($1.52 vs $1.40 consensus hurdle).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash flow generated from operating activities of continuing operations ($303.2M in Q3 2026; $571.5M 9M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Cash reinvestment in manufacturing plant expansion, cleanrooms, and testing facilities ($37.0M in Q3 2026; $94.6M 9M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow minus CapEx, stock-based compensation, and finance leases ($446.0M 9M YTD forensic balance).
tooltip_definitions.Thermal Management Divestiture: Reclassification of legacy heat tracing business as discontinued operations following its strategic sale, crystallizing pure-play electrical focus.
tooltip_definitions.Consolidated Gross Profit: Net sales minus cost of goods sold ($542.9M in Q3 2026, delivering 35.84% gross margin).
tooltip_definitions.Selling, General & Administrative: Corporate overhead, sales force compensation, and field marketing expenses ($236.3M in Q3 2026, 15.60% of sales).
tooltip_definitions.Research & Development: Targeted engineering spending on next-generation modular liquid cooling architectures and power interconnects ($24.3M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Full-Year Guidance Raise: Upward revision of FY2026 net sales growth to 48%-49% and Adjusted EPS to $5.36-$5.39 (up from prior $5.00-$5.10).
tooltip_definitions.Options Volatility Regime: Weekly ATM straddle implied a ±14.04% move; realized move was +1.05% after-hours, triggering severe volatility crush.
tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Value to EBITDA: Valuation multiple comparing enterprise value ($21.77B) against operating earnings before interest, taxes, and depreciation (~18.5x).
